offers_products.reason: MasTec sells construction and infrastructure work, not manufactured goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Builds pipelines, power plants, transmission lines, communications networks and civil projects; engineering and installation services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are utilities, energy and communications companies; EV charging for residential is minor.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves utilities, pipeline operators, telecom carriers, power developers and data center owners.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue mostly comes from construction projects, though some customers give repeat master service agreements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Pipeline, power plant and construction projects can be deferred when capital spending is cut.

big_ticket.reason: Large infrastructure construction projects such as pipelines, power plants and solar farms are big, infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Work depends heavily on equipment fleets and project execution, not mainly staff time as in consulting or staffing.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large utilities, energy companies, telecom carriers and major infrastructure owners.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs large fleets of construction equipment and vehicles, with ongoing capital investment.
